featureScope: Current SCOPE inspection dashboard inside Workbench Simple; no separate HTML application; existing eight tools retained.

toolchain.note: The environment Java 21 install lacks ct.sym; a separate checksum-verified complete JDK 17 was used without changing host Java settings.

releaseGate.note: The final complete regression counts, packaging result, CI and merge provenance are recorded outside the immutable Simple source package at this repository link.

metricRules: Cards and unfiltered lists share the same projection.
Distinct observed paths use method and exact PacketRef URL when available; only displayed URLs are masked.
Existing global coverage and unresolved relative candidates are linked only by the real runner fingerprint.
Candidates, observed differences and identity review records are not confirmed vulnerability counts.
Sent/budget is request-budget usage, not a site-wide completion percentage.
Account-less candidates remain global; raw original packets are never fabricated for candidate-only rows.
Large projections run on one daemon worker; a previous projection is shown only for the same run/account with an explicit updating label, and every card/list uses that one projection.
notRun: live external targets or external OAST/BApp/AI services
captureProvenance: Production Swing components rendered with explicitly synthetic packet/API adapters. These images are not native Burp GUI screenshots.
